record.question: The average of the highest and lowest annual production values shown in the bar graph is:
record.explanation: The original graph labels the minimum as 60 and maximum as 90 thousand units. Their average is (60+90)÷2=75 thousand units, option A. This uses the numeric labels; the original bar lengths are inconsistent. Verified worked solution; unofficial. No matching official answer key was found in the targeted source search on 24 October 2026.
record.direction: Direction (Questions 73–75): The bar graph below shows the annual production (in thousand units) of a factory from 2018 to 2023.
record.passage:
Annual production (thousand units), as labelled in the source graph:
2018: 60
2019: 65
2020: 72
2021: 78
2022: 85
2023: 90

The original graph is preserved below. The printed bar lengths are not consistently proportional to these numeric labels.
